body: Codex access tokens (<home>/auth.json tokens.access_token, tokens.account_id) are JWTs; agx reads the `exp` claim locally so an expired Codex login says 'expired' instead of failing with a 401 (v0.3.0, 2026-09-26). Codex stores no email/plan locally: they are only known after a usage fetch, so `agx profiles` shows them blank. Running `codex` once refreshes an expired login.
